scenarios.prompt: A duelist enemy has pokes and two high-impact attacks. Publish logical move budgets, intended counters and encounter overlap constraints without changing player timing systems.

criteria.budget: Each move publishes logical startup/active/recovery/repeat and reaction/range data.
criteria.encounter: High-impact move count and punishability are project-specific and compose with group-tactics concurrency.
criteria.evidence: Tests kit solo and in representative encounters without secretly changing unrelated player timing.
